{{Quote|The fewer mouths at the table, the bigger my slice of pikatta pie.|Head of Teyr naturalization|<ref name="EGTPAM" />}}
'''Pikatta Pie''' was a rich and thick [[Pie/Legends|pie]] made with [[Wheat/Legends|wheat]], [[Bantha butter/Legends|Bantha Butter]] that acted as a [[Sugar/Legends|sweet]] glaze, and [[Water/Legends|water]], and the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish's]] [[Color/Legends|beige]] crust was stuffed with a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] filling. The pie was thought to have been invented by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Hodor]] of<ref name="SWG" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EGTPAM" /> [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]].<ref name="SWG" /> Teyr naturalization's [[Head of Teyr naturalization|head]] once joked that the less immigrants Teyr had, and therefore the less [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] to [[Diet/Legends|feed]], the larger the head's slice of Pikatta Pie could be.<ref name="EGTPAM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pikatta Pie was first mentioned in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EGTPAM" /> It made its first appearance as a craftable item in the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> which closed in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> ''Galaxies'' was also the first source to fully capitalize the subject's name.<ref name="SWG" />
